title: Switch between current product truth and one proposed change
statement: As a reviewer, I can view the application as it exists now or focus on one proposed change, so that I can switch between lasting context and change-specific evidence.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A comparison uses the proposed change's merge base as its starting point.
The Changed view shows each documentation record added, revised, or retired by the comparison.
The Affected view shows unchanged documentation that the comparison may invalidate.
The Code view groups changed lines under the explanations that reference them.
The Code view lists changed lines that have no explanation.
The same selected comparison scopes the reviewer view, status report, and structured queries.
The reviewer clearly distinguishes current documentation from change review.
Change review keeps the current product documentation reachable.
A feature, story, or criterion lists the reviews that changed its explained code.
A related-reviews list identifies itself as derived from code links.
